countries.reasoning: Based on USGS 2023 and 2024 data, China dominates global magnesium metal production with well-documented large-scale production capacity and stable output.
Russia is a known significant magnesium producer with stable production reported by USGS and industry sources, though less dominant than China.
The US has consistent domestic production mainly from the Great Salt Lake, well documented in USGS releases.
Israel produces magnesium primarily from the Dead Sea brine, with solid but somewhat limited public detailed data.
Kazakhstan is a recognized producer with production estimates derived from regional mining reports and USGS approximations.
